name: TANK Mini - stock firmware V09

device_actions.label: Reload current preset

evidence.note: Normal-mode reload path derived from stock V09 firmware analysis; not yet tested on physical hardware.

warnings: Experimental action: reloading the current preset has not yet been tested on physical hardware.
Reload restores all effect states and parameters from the saved preset, including Tremolo. Unsaved live edits are discarded; the preset stored in flash is not changed.
The reload path is verified statically for normal mode. Tuner or other special modes may defer it until normal mode resumes.
Use reload as the only action in its state so restored preset values are not combined with simultaneous edits.

evidence.note: Profile derived from stock firmware V09. FX and MOD ON/OFF via CC confirmed by the user. MOD SysEx writes tested on the device; REV packets validated statically and not yet tested live from the Chocolate.

notes: Parameters use raw control values from 0 to 100. Display ranges in the catalog are metadata; no linear conversion to Hz, ms, or other units is applied.
Stock firmware does not support the continuous CC commands proposed in the experimental catalog. Parameters in this profile are encoded as SysEx.
Set the model on the device before using these actions.
A model change may load parameters asynchronously. For an ON/OFF and parameter sequence, set up the model in the preset first.
AMP and CAB: 20 model indices with shared parameter descriptors; commercial names have not been verified, so models are displayed by index.
